# Design

See ENGINEERING_STANDARDS.md for the complete specification. The architecture is seven strict layers with unidirectional dependencies. Ion remains one general identity, memory, relationship, policy, and execution continuity across every field; specialized professional environments such as the Software Studio are contextual projections of that same agent and runtime, never separate agents or replacements for the general experience. Every component is an attack surface. Every data flow is a potential exfiltration path. Security is designed before the first line of code. Tests are proof, not ritual — stubs and fakes are prohibited except at true external boundaries. The agent must be alive, not performing — emotional state modulates decision-making, not output cosmetics.
